The shared report can include the bike name, Bluetooth address, signal strength, raw bike data, timestamps, and connection log. It is sent only to the app you select.
FTMS Bike Bridge has no accounts, advertising, analytics, data sales, or developer-operated data server. Workout data and device information are not sent to the maintainer automatically.

The app scans for FTMS bikes and temporarily handles their name, Bluetooth address, and signal strength. The selected bike address is kept in private app preferences for reconnection. While connected, the app handles timestamps, speed, cadence, power, distance, and energy values supplied by the bike. Scans are not used to determine location.

Workout times, targets, distance, calories, Health Connect sync state, and timestamped bike samples are stored in a Room database in private app storage. Android application sandboxing protects the database, but the app does not separately encrypt the local database.

With permission, completed rides are written to the on-device Health Connect store as stationary cycling, including available distance, speed, cadence, power, and calorie data. The app reads its own exercise and distance records when verifying a saved workout. Revoking access stops future access but does not delete records already in Health Connect.

The workout database is eligible for Android cloud backup only when the device provides the required encryption capabilities, and for Android device-to-device transfer. Android and the connected Google account control these operations; the app maintainer cannot inspect or initiate them. App preferences, including the remembered bike address, are excluded from the backup rules.

Signed releases ask GitHub for the latest release at most once every 24 hours while the app is used and when an update check is requested manually. APK and checksum downloads occur only after you choose to update. Workout, bike, and diagnostic data are not attached, but GitHub receives ordinary network information such as the IP address.

Diagnostics remain in memory and are not uploaded automatically. Sharing opens the Android chooser and can include timestamps, connection details, bike name, Bluetooth address, signal strength, discovered characteristics, and raw FTMS data. The selected recipient then handles the report under its own privacy practices.

Configured retention removes the oldest workouts only after Health Connect sync; active, unsynced, and newest completed workouts remain protected. Clear app storage or uninstall to remove local data. Manage any Android backup separately to prevent restoration, and delete Health Connect records separately.

The app uses Android private storage, blocks cleartext network traffic, and uses HTTPS. Updates are checked against their checksum, package, version, and signing certificate. No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed completely secure.
The English policy in the GitHub repository is canonical. Use a public GitHub issue for an ordinary question without personal information, or private vulnerability reporting for sensitive details.
